simple.meaning: שְׁאֵלָא (shᵉʼêlâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, a question (at law), i.e. judicial decision or mandate.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁאֵלָא (H7595) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שְׁאֵלָא (H7595) before moving outward to related references.
